name: Bestow Pact Malady, Greater
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [curse, mind-affecting, [pact]; Level cleric 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as bestow malady, except your touch causes the target to contract a major pact malady. Randomly determine the pact malady that is afflicted to the target using Table 9-4: Pact Maladies in the major maladies column.
